title: Battle of Daba
description: Hodheifa, charged by Abu Bekr with reclaiming 'Oman and Mahra and assisted by 'Ikrima, joined the loyal Prince of 'Oman. In the battle that followed the Muslims were near defeat until a column from the tribes recently reclaimed in Al-Bahrein arrived and turned the day. The mart of Daba yielded a great booty, and the royal fifth of slaves and plunder was sent to Medina. Hodheifa was left as governor of 'Oman. Dated to the year 0632 by the source.

sources.citation: Sir William Muir, The Caliphate: Its Rise, Decline, and Fall, "II A.H. 632-633 A.D."
